job: Edit a set of names with values as rows.
purpose: For OAuth scopes and their labels, request headers, environment variables. Each pair is a row with its own remove button. Without script it is a text area of "name = value" lines; with it, rows and one hidden input post the same lines or a JSON object (data-format="json"). A name used twice marks both invalid and stops the form posting.
useWhen: The value is a map: scopes, headers, labels, environment variables.
The server stores an object and nobody should type JSON.

avoidWhen.when: The value is a flat list.
The value is one setting with a fixed name.
The data is a table people read and sort.
Raw config is the actual input.

states.name: duplicate name
states.how: aria-invalid="true" on both names and data-invalid on the group

states.name: read-only
states.how: readonly on the source text area

variants.useWhen: Names are identifiers and values are prose, as in scopes.
Values are identifiers and names are prose.
Both columns are identifiers, as in headers.

keyboard.does: In a name: moves to its value. In a value: adds a row below.
In an empty name and value: removes the row.
